witnesses.name: Clip/cue mapping arithmetic re-verification and structure result
witnesses.label: executed_by_candidate
witnesses.scope: Floor mapping p(s) = q + floor((s-t)*Rproj/Rsrc), inverse s(p) = t + floor((p-q)*Rsrc/Rproj), Lproj = len*Rproj//Rsrc: 1:1 involutivity over a full clip; boundary exactness (trim start to clip head, final sample to last project frame, one-past-end to first orphan position); 44.1k to 48k roundtrip failures 4516 of 4547 probes; new structure result: roundtrip succeeds if and only if the source offset is divisible by 147 (= 44100 / gcd(44100, 48000)); Lproj(441000) = 480000.
witnesses.justified_expected_behavior: At integer 1:1 ratio the mapping must be exactly involutive and boundary-exact; at 44100 to 48000 most samples cannot roundtrip, which is the documented justification for anchoring cues in source samples; the divisibility structure follows from gcd arithmetic.
witnesses.stdout_summary: A1 True; A2 head->2000 tail->6999 one-past-end->7000; B1 4516 of 4547; B2 True (period 147); C1 480000; FW1 OK.
witnesses.corroboration: Independently reproduces research-stage RW1 (4516/4547) and strengthens it with the mod-147 structure.
witnesses.limits: Pure integer arithmetic; no audio I/O, no libsndfile/libsamplerate, no application code. Proves properties of the proposed formula only.

witnesses.name: Display timecode rounding rule checks (rev 2)
witnesses.label: executed_by_candidate
witnesses.scope: ms = (p*1000 + rate//2) // rate with negative clamp: zero; single frame truncates to 0 ms; 24 frames at 48 kHz = exact half millisecond rounds UP to 1 ms; 23 frames stays 0; one frame under one second displays 01.000 (nearest-ms); half a second exactly 00.500; one frame before two hours ALSO displays 02:00:00.000 (C2 display property); negative clamps to 00:00:00.000; float pitfall preserved (2.675 formats as 2.67).
witnesses.justified_expected_behavior: The brief requires defined rounding and boundary behavior for displayed timecodes; nearest-ms half-up integer math is deterministic and the display-property case shows why timecodes must never be anchors.
witnesses.corroboration: Consistent with research-stage RW2; adds the one-frame-before-two-hours display case.
witnesses.limits: Arithmetic-only isolated check; no GUI, playback, or export integration.

witnesses.name: Size census, memory arithmetic, and cache-size correction
witnesses.label: executed_by_candidate
witnesses.scope: 2 h at 48 kHz = 345,600,000 frames; RIFF data-chunk bytes for 24-bit at 1/2/4/8 channels versus 4,294,967,295 (1,036,800,000 fits; 2,073,600,000 fits; 4,147,200,000 fits; 8,294,400,000 exceeds); whole-file float32 stereo footprint 2,764,800,000 bytes = 2.5749 GiB; 2 s stereo window 768,000 bytes = 750 KiB; corrected cache math: 1,350,000 min/max points at 256 spp = 5,400,000 bytes = 5.15 MiB; research-stage 6.7M-frame figure is 51.6x low.
witnesses.justified_expected_behavior: These constants size the export RF64 refusal boundary, the forbidden whole-file access pattern, the permitted window size, and the corrected per-source cache footprint (correction C1).
witnesses.stdout_summary: channels table with over-flag only at 8; whole-file 2.5749 GiB; window 750 KiB; corrected cache 5.15 MiB; FW3 OK.
witnesses.corroboration: Matches research-stage RW3 on every shared constant; corrects only proposal section 7.2's prose estimate, which RW3 had never asserted.
witnesses.limits: Arithmetic only; does not measure a real renderer or the libsndfile RF64 writer.

witnesses.name: Join lengths and equal-power crossfade property
witnesses.label: executed_by_candidate
witnesses.scope: Butt join length = lenA + lenB (240,000 frames); crossfade length = lenA + lenB - D (239,760 at D = 240); cos/sin equal-power ramps have power sum 1 across the fade within 1e-9; edge gains correct (1,0 to 0.0065, 1.0); worst-case in-phase full-scale peak through the fade is 1.414214.
witnesses.justified_expected_behavior: Equal-power definition implies unit power sum; the 1.414 in-phase peak justifies making the export clipping census mandatory (correction C5).
witnesses.stdout_summary: butt 240000; xfade 239760; power sum True; edges True; peak 1.414214; FW4 OK.
witnesses.limits: Formula-level only; no claim about perceived transition quality.
